doc.title: Al Grey interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995

title: Being treated like an artist in Europe
summary: In England Grey was treated as an artist, in contrast to the US, which made him reflect on the difference.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: In other words, you were treated differently in Europe?

Completely different. You was treated like an artist. Like artists are supposed to be treated. And they would roll out the royal carpet to you and you was treated that way. And you was accepted that way. Well, I myself, leaving the United States, it was a long time in my belief, gee, how is it this much of a difference, you see? And again, a lot of this that I am speaking about, wasn’t permissible a few years ago to even make statements.
